_comment: Kinsbaile Cavalier (2026-09-28), the STATIC subtype double-strike lord. Guards both halves of the card in one fixture: the search must CAST it off exactly four Plains, and the grant must then double the whole Knight board. Four Plains pay {3}{W} exactly, the library is all Plains so no other line exists, and the three Venerable Knights are vanilla 2/1 Knights with no lord on board, so the arithmetic is unambiguous. WITH the grant: the Cavalier is summoning-sick on turn 4, so the three Knights swing 3 x (2 x 2) = 12 and the opponent falls 20 -> 8; on turn 5 the Cavalier joins for 2 x 2 = 4 more, so 16 lands and the opponent ends at -8. WITHOUT the grant (or if the Cavalier is never cast) the same board deals 6 a turn and does not kill until turn 7, so the assertion discriminates on BOTH win turn and final life. Note the grant reads 'Knight creatures you control', NOT 'Other' -- the Cavalier's own 2 power is doubled too, which is the -8 rather than -6. It also proves the grant is not Valiant Knight's activated team_pump: no mana is left to activate anything after the cast.
